text: Per its own 2026 Form 20-F, América Móvil's shares trade on the Mexican Stock Exchange and, as ADSs, on the NYSE (symbol AMX); Carlos Slim Helú, 'together with his sons, daughters and grandchildren (together, the "Slim Family") may be deemed to control us,' based on SEC beneficial-ownership filings. The same filing confirms América Móvil was formed when Telmex, 'a fixed-line Mexican telecommunications operator privatized in 1990,' spun off its wireless business — and states that Telcel, not Claro, is the Mexican brand name.

source.name: América Móvil, S.A.B. de C.V., Form 20-F (Annual Report)
source.quote: Carlos Slim Helú, together with his sons, daughters and grandchildren (together, the "Slim Family") may be deemed to control us.
